decisions.decision: Promote EnforcementReceipt.entry_path/token_arm to core EntryPath/TokenArm enums
decisions.rationale: OPERATOR DECISION mid-Wave-1. As first written they were &'static str — structurally content-free (good for D-14) but practically un-deserializable, which would have blocked Plan 118-09's receipt show/list at Wave 5. Enums are content-free by construction AND round-trippable AND compile-time exhaustive. Rejected alternatives: owned String (loses the type-level guarantee) and a duplicate read-side DTO (two shapes to keep in sync forever).

decisions.decision: Also re-export EntryPath from core in layer_registry.rs, not just LayerId
decisions.rationale: orchestrator-directed extension to 118-03 Task 1; identical variant set so all call sites kept compiling, and it avoids the duplicate-shape drift the operator had just rejected

decisions.decision: Do NOT unify WindowsTokenArm with core TokenArm
decisions.rationale: token_arm_to_receipt in attestation.rs is already an exhaustive match with no wildcard, so adding a variant to either enum is a compile error — the drift guard already exists and unification would be churn for no safety gain
